_format: Synthetic journey seed for POST /__test/seed {fixture:'journeys/<file>'} (SPEC §5.9). databases: dbName -> documents to put (SPEC §3 shapes; ids '<type>:<key>'; the personal db of person:<key> is 'person-<key>'). packages: fixture package folders (relative to acceptance/fixtures) to import into classId (running the gate) and publish when publish is true; publishing creates the class's day documents from its schedule. joinCodes: one-time class join codes to create. Seeds are additive: later files only add documents. Seeded attempts with publishedAt and score also get their grade ledger entry (SPEC §4.9).
